entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, Alex. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. It's not working right.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a defect. The heart rate tracking is a joke. I'll be in the middle of a hard workout and it'll read my pulse at a resting rate. Frankly, the sensor is garbage.
I understand how frustrating that would be. Inaccurate readings defeat the whole purpose. I can quickly walk you through a sensor reset, it sometimes resolves calibration issues.

Listen, I appreciate the offer, but I **don't have time** to be tech support for your product. I've already tried restarting it. At this point, I **just want money** back. Can we please start the **refund** process?
Of course. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Let me just check the policy. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the band was delivered to you 25 days ago, on December 19th.
That sounds about right. So, what does that mean for me? If a full refund is off the table, would you be able to offer a partial credit or maybe a discount code for the trouble?

That won't be necessary. I'm checking our policy now, and it looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only at day 25, you're well within the window for a full refund.
Oh. Really? I was expecting this to be more complicated. That's great news.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email on file right now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed once we receive it.
Wow, that was simple. Thank you, Alex. I appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
